title: Vintaged 36-month real-misalignment anchor (realized-CPI PPP-deviation class) with absolute-band regime activation
mechanism: The forced, slow actors are cross-border price-takers: importers, exporters, corporate treasurers and reserve managers whose cost bases, wholesale contracts and hedging tenors reset on quarterly-to-annual cycles; they respond to a persistent real exchange-rate misalignment only after contracts roll, while the marginal monthly price-setter is fast financial flow that ignores purchasing-power anchors until misalignment is extreme. The effect exists because this slow/fast wedge is the documented PPP puzzle (Rogoff 1996: real exchange rates are volatile yet mean-revert with a multi-year half-life; Lothian-Taylor: long-run PPP holds over decades; Taylor-Peel-Sarno 2001: reversion is non-linear and ACCELERATES in the size of the deviation) -- once the vintaged real misalignment breaches wide absolute bands, the stabilizing real-economy flow dominates the financial flow and the currency reverts over multi-month horizons. The observable, per pair, is dev(t) = 36-month log FX return minus the vintaged 36-month cumulative relative CPI (home minus US), built as the sum of three consecutive within-snapshot y/y steps per AX2-C3 (rebase-safe: a base change rescales both ends of any y/y, so y/y steps are rebase-invariant exactly; a window spanning a REBASE_CLASS event is marked UNDEFINED and the pair force-exits -- no splicing, no splice-ratio adjustment), consumed daily at 16:00 America/New_York from as-of vintages (AX2-C1/C4). The family MUST fail when the misalignment reflects structural forces the monetary anchor cannot price -- terms-of-trade regime shifts (commodity booms repricing AUD/NZD/CAD fair value), productivity differentials, or durable rate-differential regimes that legitimately sustain wide deviations -- because then the deviation persists and no reversion arrives; it MUST also fail if the +7d sham-calendar neighbour reproduces the anchor (print-freshness carries no information, the cluster #10/#12 verdict), if the DGS10 exposure-form control reproduces it (nominal-yield shadow), or if publication lags (AU/NZ median 41d, GB/CA median 42d) leave the state too stale to matter after costs.
literature_anchors: Rogoff (1996) 'The purchasing power parity puzzle' -- real exchange-rate mean reversion, 3-5y half-life; the canonical valuation-anchor mechanism
Lothian & Taylor (1996) 'Real exchange rate behavior: the recent float from the perspective of the past two centuries' -- long-run PPP as a slow anchor

Taylor, Peel & Sarno (2001) 'Nonlinear mean reversion in real exchange rates' -- reversion accelerates with deviation size; justifies ABSOLUTE misalignment bands (±10%) rather than standardized z-scores
Fama (1984) forward-premium puzzle lineage + long-horizon relative-inflation predictability of nominal FX moves -- realized relative inflation as the slow anchor's content

This is the second preregistered V4 inflation-axis class: 'real-differential and PPP-deviation classes, recorded DATA_BLOCKED_VALID in V4 and carried since' (PLAN_forex_v8.md §2; ledger V4 row) -- now fundable on vintaged CPI legs per the P2 census

universe.note: 6 of the 7 G10 spot pairs. USDJPY is EXCLUDED: USDJPY's home-economy realized-CPI leg (JP) is BLOCKED_DATA per AX2-C6 (OECD feed dead since 2021-06, no vintaged successor); a PPP-deviation anchor for USDJPY is unfundable this cycle. The mechanism is pair-specific, so USDJPY cannot borrow another economy's anchor.

instrument_leg_disclosure.what: The FX leg of dev(t) is the traded pair's OWN daily 16:00-NY close history: ln(S(t)/S(t-36m)). It is the instrument being traded, not an external conditioning field; a PPP deviation is undefined without it, and AX2-C2 explicitly sanctions 'PPP deviations ... computed INSIDE one as-of snapshot' as a single-snapshot transform. No other price-derived feature (returns, momentum, ranges, PCA, leads) enters any computation -- the FX leg is a single 36-month point-to-point log ratio refreshed daily.
instrument_leg_disclosure.price_derived_class_check: the 36-month horizon places the FX leg in a different regime from every forbidden price class (V1/V2 session/range: intraday; V7 lead-lag: cross-pair daily leads; V6 PC1: cross-pair daily PCA); ancestry rho at D2 is expected |rho|<=0.20 and is measured, not argued.
instrument_leg_disclosure.rebase_interaction: the FX leg is a market price (no revisions/rebases); only the CPI legs carry the rebase event table.

transform_semantics.dev: dev_pair(t) = ln(S(t)/S(t-36m)) - [ home_36m_infl(t) - us_36m_infl(t) ], positive dev = home currency REAL-OVERVALUED vs USD over the trailing 36 months; computed inside one as-of snapshot per clock (AX2-C2)
transform_semantics.accumulation: home/us 36m inflation = sum of three consecutive NON-OVERLAPPING within-snapshot y/y log steps at the leg's native periodicity (3 x 12m for monthly legs = 36m; 3 x 4-quarter for quarterly legs = 36m). y/y steps are exactly rebase-invariant (a base rescale cancels in any P/P_12m computed on one base); a 36m accumulation therefore fails ONLY if a REBASE_CLASS event (>2% per AX2-C3 event table) splits one of its three y/y steps at that vintage -- in that case dev_pair(t) is UNDEFINED.
transform_semantics.undefined_state_handling: while dev_pair is UNDEFINED (rebase-spanning window or un-refreshed trims), the pair holds NO ENTRY and any open position force-exits at the next clock; entries resume only after three clean post-event y/y steps rebuild the accumulation. This is the preregistered rebase handling -- no splice-ratio adjustment, no level-level conditioning across a rebase boundary (AX2-C3).
transform_semantics.bands: absolute log-unit bands per Taylor-Peel-Sarno nonlinear-reversion calibrations: enter |dev| >= 0.0953 (+/-10% real misalignment), exit |dev| <= 0.0488 (hysteresis at half the entry band). No trailing z-score (deliberately: avoids trailing-window data hunger on the 33-print AU/NZ quarterly legs and keeps the anchor absolute).
transform_semantics.lags: no discretionary lags; each leg enters at first clock strictly after ITS OWN available_time (AX2-C4); dev is recomputed from the latest bound values of all legs (a step-function state on the daily grid)

decision_clock.rule: AX2-C4; the state is stepwise (updates at CPI print availability), evaluated on every trading day; entries/exits only at the daily clock
decision_clock.calendar_conditioning: the book holds through prints and is not windowed around any release instant; however, the anchor state refreshes at vintaged print availability, so the +7d sham-calendar variant is MANDATORY and occupies the neighbour arm (see arms/falsification_rule)

warmup.description: No in-S0 z-warmup (absolute bands). The 36m accumulations require vintaged CPI history back to 2015-01 and pair closes back to 2015-04 so that dev is defined from the S0 start (2018-04-04).
warmup.data_requirements_declared: D1-DECLARED per p2_conditioning_clocks_v8.json inclusion_rule_r3 ('Long-run PPP fields requiring deeper price-level history are a D1-declared data requirement to be staged separately before I/Q -- not part of this census'): (a) staged vintaged CPI history 2015-01-01..2018-03-31 for the 8 legs above (FRED/ALFRED, as-of semantics identical to AX2-C1); (b) staged daily pair closes 2015-04-01..2018-04-03 for the 6 pairs (same free-source lineage as prior forex cycles), 16:00-NY clock. If staging cannot fund ANY pair's deep history, that pair is dropped; if fewer than 4 pairs fund, the family closes BLOCKED_DATA pre-scoring.

entry_exit_fills.activation: enter when |dev| >= 0.0953; direction frozen (mean-reversion): dev >= +0.0953 (home REAL-OVERVALUED) => SHORT home currency (e.g., sell EURUSD); dev <= -0.0953 (home REAL-UNDERVALUED) => LONG home currency
entry_exit_fills.exit: exit when |dev| <= 0.0488 OR after 63 business days max hold, whichever first; force-exit on UNDEFINED dev (rebase-spanning window or post-trim tail)
entry_exit_fills.reentry: allowed at the next clock if the activation condition re-fires (persistent misalignment beyond max-hold re-quotes rather than rescuing a position); max one position per pair at any time
entry_exit_fills.fills: at the decision-instant price (daily 16:00-NY close snapshot); no intraday actions
entry_exit_fills.sizing: fixed notional 1 unit per pair; per-trade return in bps of notional

costs.books: dual book: price-only and financing-adjusted; gates on fin-adj at tier 2.0 primary
costs.cost_sanity: 63-business-day max hold => per-trade gross edge must exceed 6.0 bps; a multi-quarter reversion with misalignment bands of ±10% implies expected reversion drift an order of magnitude above the cost bar IF the mechanism is live -- arithmetic, not hope, decides at scoring

arms.name: 36m vintaged real-misalignment anchor, absolute ±10% bands (fresh as-of legs)
arms.driver: dev_pair(t) per transform_semantics, all legs at AX2-C4 availability
arms.activation: |dev| >= 0.0953 enter, |dev| <= 0.0488 exit, 63bd max hold, mean-reversion direction
arms.mechanism_bearing_component: pair-specific vintaged real-misalignment anchor PLUS its print-freshness (the timing at which each leg's value becomes bindable)

arms.name: +7d sham-calendar variant of the anchor (cluster #10/#12 mandatory sham)
arms.driver: identical book to the anchor EXCEPT every CPI leg's available_time is shifted +7 calendar days before the AX2-C4 binding (signal refresh lags 7 days on every print)
arms.delta_vs_anchor: ONLY the availability timing of the mechanism-bearing state changes; series, bands, direction, holds, costs identical
arms.expected_behaviour: if vintaged print-freshness is mechanism-bearing, the sham is same-sign but materially weaker (or negative -- the V6 precedent: a sham that LOSES while the anchor EARNS is evidence of genuine timing information); a sham that REPRODUCES the anchor is the falsification verdict
arms.placement_note: house standard (V5 precedent, cluster instance #10) places the +7d sham-calendar variant in a non-anchor arm; AX2-C8 binds the control arm to SAME as-of semantics, so the sham cannot also be the control without violating C8 -- hence sham=neighbour, DGS10=control.

arms.name: DGS10 nominal-yield exposure-form control (AX2-C8 mandatory)
arms.driver: Delta_dgs10(t) = DGS10(t) - DGS10(t-36m) in percentage points, as-of semantics identical
arms.activation: Delta >= +1.0pp => LONG USD basket (the convenient exposure: rising US nominal yields are USD-supportive); Delta <= -1.0pp => SHORT USD basket; exit |Delta| <= 0.5pp or 63bd max hold; universe/clock/fills/costs identical to the anchor
arms.delta_vs_anchor: the mechanism-bearing component (pair-specific real-misalignment anchor) is REPLACED by the 36m nominal-yield change form; everything else identical
arms.identifiability_note: identifiability is preserved in the time-series dimension (same pairs, clock, holds, costs, driver cadence); the cross-section is necessarily USD-wide because no foreign nominal-yield series is authorized -- this is inherent to AX2-C8 and is disclosed, not hidden.

control_identifiability: Each non-anchor arm differs from the anchor in EXACTLY one mechanism-bearing component: neighbour = availability timing (+7d), control = driver identity (PPP anchor -> nominal-yield change). No arm subsumes another: the anchor is pair-specific and price-level-based; the control is USD-wide and rate-based; the neighbour is the anchor degraded only in freshness. Near-identical or self-subsuming control risk is nil by construction.

falsification_rule.evaluation_book: financing-adjusted, tier 2.0 primary, pooled S0 usable grid
rules: R1 sham-reproduction kill (cluster #10/#12): neighbour (+7d sham) fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND >= 0.5 x anchor fin-adj expectancy => print-freshness carries no information, the anchor is a stale-state artefact => FAMILY DIES.
R2 nominal-shadow kill (AX2-C8): control fin-adj expectancy > 0 AND >= 0.5 x anchor fin-adj expectancy => PPP reversion was nominal-yield reversion => FAMILY DIES.

R3 mechanical reject: anchor fin-adj expectancy <= 0 => gate 1 rejects; if the per-pair breakdown localizes losses in terms-of-trade currencies (AUD/NZD/CAD) that is the recorded structural-regime failure mode of the anchor, not a path to a trimmed universe (universe was frozen at D1 -- altering it post-hoc is rescue).

R4 survival requires: anchor > 0 AND R1/R2 clear AND all ten p3 baseline gates pass (pf>=1.10, >=2/3 positive folds, pair concentration <=0.40 -- watch GBPUSD/USDCAD whose legs trim at ~2025-05, break-even <=1.5 bps, dual-book no inversion, LOPO sign-robust across the 6 pairs, stress tier 2.0 non-negative margin, mechanism sanity).
sham negative is EVIDENCE FOR the mechanism (V6 precedent: genuine calendar information) and is recorded, never chased with sign flips.

sham_calendar.applicability: MANDATORY -- the anchor state refreshes at vintaged CPI print availability
sham_calendar.variant: +7d sham-calendar variant of the anchor occupies the neighbour arm (fully specified above)
sham_calendar.auxiliary: the control arm additionally records its own +7d availability-shift variant (DGS10 consumed 7 days late) in the diag/control_rows artifact as a staleness diagnostic; it is not a scored arm and consumes no slot (AX2-C8 requires the scored control at same-as-of semantics)

expected_failure_interpretation: If R1 fires: the deviation state is causally inert -- decisions do not depend on when prints arrive, so the PIT-vintage freshness that justified the whole census carries no content on this class; family dies as calendar-non-causal (the #10/#12 verdict pattern). If R2 fires: PPP reversion was nominal-rate reversion wearing price levels -- shadow recorded, no descendants. If R3 fires with term-of-trade concentration: the monetary anchor is invalid for commodity currencies in 2020-22 -- a genuine mechanism boundary, recorded as the expected failure mode of the class. If gates kill on costs/folds/stress while R1/R2 are clear: the anchor is real but its reversion horizon is longer than the S0 grid can monetize after 6.0 bps round trips. Every failure falsifies the family; no band, hold, universe or sign may be re-entered (unused slots never reassigned).

fold_structure.rule: equal thirds of the usable decision grid from S0 start (deep-history staged), split mechanically at run time; per-pair trims shorten F3 for GB/CA (~2025-05) and AU/NZ (~2025-03)

approx_bounds.F3: 2023-02-05 .. 2025-07-24 (truncated per pair at its last valid conditioning clock per AX2-C5)

fold_structure.gate_binding: positive populated folds >= 2 of 3; each fold must be populated for evaluability

expected_decision_count_sanity.usable_clocks_S0: ~1835 per pair from 2018-04-04 (GBPUSD/USDCAD to ~2025-05, AUDUSD/NZDUSD to ~2025-03 per AX2-C5 trims)
expected_decision_count_sanity.expected_activation_share: 0.25-0.45 of clocks (G10 real misalignments are large and persistent: 10%+ deviations from 3y PPP were common over 2018-2025; hysteresis exit at 5% keeps episodes long)
expected_decision_count_sanity.expected_entries_pooled: ~60-160 anchor entries across 6 pairs (episodes of 30-63 business days; persistent misalignment re-quotes through the 63bd max hold)
expected_decision_count_sanity.non_vacuity_floor: >= 50 pooled anchor entries AND >= 10 anchor entries in each of the 3 folds; below the floors the family closes VACUOUS pre-scoring (data-adequacy closure; unused slots never reassigned)
expected_decision_count_sanity.cost_viability_note: long holds amortize the 6.0 bps round trip; the sanity check is that EPISODE counts (not clock counts) are what must clear the fold-population gates

lane_boundary_note: A4 owns plain expectation-level conditioning (breakeven level/change, real-yield level/change, expectation series +/- foreign realized-inflation legs as INPUT to expectation books). This proposal consumes NO expectation series in its anchor at all: the mechanism-bearing ingredient is a DEVIATION-FROM-ANCHOR structure (36m real misalignment vs a purchasing-power anchor) with absolute-band regime activation -- a different observable pair (price-level anchor vs FX) and a different mechanism family (valuation-anchor reversion, the V4-carried PPP-deviation class). If D2 novelty measurement finds collision with an A4 proposal, the pre-selection rho/novelty measurement decides; nothing here asserts immunity in lieu of measurement.

ancestry_distinctness.vs_range_structures_V2: no ranges, breaks or compression observables
ancestry_distinctness.vs_policy_rate_carry_V3R_and_relabels: no policy rates; no yield differentials; the DGS10 control MEASURES any nominal kinship instead of asserting its absence; expected pooled |rho|<=0.20 vs carry-region exposures at D2
ancestry_distinctness.vs_commodity_bloc_risk_off_V4: no event baskets or risk-off gates; AUD/NZD are traded on valuation bands, not event conditioning
ancestry_distinctness.vs_release_window_avoidance_V5: no windows around releases; the mandatory +7d sham measures any residual timing artefact
ancestry_distinctness.vs_reaction_direction_V6_V7: no conditioning on release signs or post-release direction; positions persist through prints
ancestry_distinctness.vs_eurusd_lead_lag_V7: no cross-pair leads; drivers are pair-specific vintaged CPI anchors
ancestry_distinctness.vs_usd_pc1_gated_reversal_V6: no price PCA; the reversal gate is a pair-specific macro deviation, not a cross-pair factor
ancestry_distinctness.vs_real_yield_differential_lane1: no real-yield series consumed at all (lane 1 is BLOCKED and unfundable; this class needs only realized price levels + FX)
ancestry_distinctness.vs_carry_front_door_V4_rho: D2 pre-selection rho measurement against all forbidden ancestry is expected |rho|<=0.20 and is the binding test, never argued

ax2_compliance.AX2_C1: as-of pulls only for every leg including deep-history staging (declared data requirement)
ax2_compliance.AX2_C2: dev, accumulations and Delta_dgs10 computed inside single as-of snapshots; no cross-vintage splicing
ax2_compliance.AX2_C3: y/y-step accumulation is exactly rebase-invariant; REBASE_CLASS-spanning windows marked UNDEFINED with preregistered force-exit/no-entry; rebase event table ships with the dataset and appears in diagnostics; no splice-ratio adjustment anywhere
ax2_compliance.AX2_C4: each leg consumed at first daily 16:00-NY clock strictly after its own available_time; mutation-test binding per leg class (GB monthly PASS x2, EZ monthly PASS x2, AU quarterly PASS x2, US daily PASS already evidenced)
ax2_compliance.AX2_C5: GB/CA tails at ~2025-05, AU/NZ at ~2025-03 honoured (force-exit at trim; no current-vintage backfill)
ax2_compliance.AX2_C8: DGS10 nominal-yield exposure-form control present as the control arm under identical as-of semantics
